description.en: Your Actions runs, the pull requests waiting for your review and your own.
description.es: Tus ejecuciones de Actions, las pull requests que te toca revisar y las tuyas.

description.en: Recent GitHub Actions workflow runs: broken first, then running (with a timer) and queued, passing last.
description.es: Las últimas ejecuciones de GitHub Actions: lo roto primero, luego lo que corre (con cronómetro) y espera, lo que pasa al final.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: 0 = as many as fit. A number shows that many, in rows of a readable size (fewer when the tile is too small for them); the rest are counted in "+N more".

help.en: 0 = as many as fit. A number shows that many, in rows of a readable size (fewer when the tile is too small for them); the rest are counted in "+N more".
help.es: 0 = las que quepan. Con un número se ven esas, en filas de un tamaño legible (menos si la tesela no da para ellas); el resto se cuenta en «+N más».

layout.title: Row layout
layout.description: Automatic: the widget picks by the tile's shape.

help.en: Automatic: the widget picks by the tile's shape.
help.es: Automático: el widget elige según la forma de la tesela.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Empty: all. Names or patterns, comma-separated: * matches anything, a leading ! leaves out (web, acme/*, !*-old).

help.en: Empty: all. Names or patterns, comma-separated: * matches anything, a leading ! leaves out (web, acme/*, !*-old).
help.es: Vacío: todos. Nombres o patrones separados por comas: * vale por cualquier cosa y un ! delante excluye (web, acme/*, !*-old).

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Empty: every branch. Names or patterns, comma-separated (main, release/*, !dependabot/*).

help.en: Empty: every branch. Names or patterns, comma-separated (main, release/*, !dependabot/*).
help.es: Vacío: todas las ramas. Nombres o patrones separados por comas (main, release/*, !dependabot/*).

hidePassing.title: Hide passing runs

onlyLatest.title: Only the latest run per workflow and branch

description.en: Three numbers: reviews waiting for you, failing runs and unread notifications (when the token can read them). Coloured only when they ask for you.
description.es: Tres números: revisiones pendientes, ejecuciones que fallan y notificaciones sin leer (si el token puede leerlas). Con color solo cuando te reclaman.

description.en: Actions runs of your repos, your open pull requests and the ones you are asked to review, through a token or the gh CLI.
description.es: Las ejecuciones de Actions de tus repos, tus pull requests abiertas y las que te piden revisar, con un token o con el CLI gh.

host.title: GitHub host
host.description: Empty = github.com. A GitHub Enterprise Server host uses its /api/v3.

help.en: Empty = github.com. A GitHub Enterprise Server host uses its /api/v3.
help.es: Vacío = github.com. Un servidor GitHub Enterprise usa su /api/v3.

token.title: Access token
token.description: Fine-grained token with read access to Actions, Pull requests and Metadata, or a classic one with repo and read:org (and notifications for the inbox count). Empty = use the gh CLI and its login. Secret: leave it empty (or a placeholder such as "<token>"). Kiosko keeps the value it already has, or asks for it in the editor.

help.en: Fine-grained token with read access to Actions, Pull requests and Metadata, or a classic one with repo and read:org (and notifications for the inbox count). Empty = use the gh CLI and its login.
help.es: Token fine-grained con lectura de Actions, Pull requests y Metadata, o uno clásico con repo y read:org (y notifications para el contador del buzón). Vacío = usar el CLI gh y su sesión.

repos.title: Repositories for Actions
repos.description: owner/repo. Empty = your most recently pushed repos.

help.en: owner/repo. Empty = your most recently pushed repos.
help.es: owner/repo. Vacío = tus repos con push más reciente.

recentRepos.title: Recent repos for Actions
recentRepos.description: Without a list of repositories: how many of your most recently pushed ones. Each costs one call per read.

help.en: Without a list of repositories: how many of your most recently pushed ones. Each costs one call per read.
help.es: Sin lista de repositorios: cuántos de los que tienen push más reciente. Cada uno cuesta una llamada por lectura.

query.title: Extra search qualifiers
query.description: Added to the pull request searches, e.g. org:acme or -repo:acme/old. Empty = everything you can see.

help.en: Added to the pull request searches, e.g. org:acme or -repo:acme/old. Empty = everything you can see.
help.es: Se añaden a las búsquedas de pull requests, p. ej. org:acme o -repo:acme/old. Vacío = todo lo que ves.

maxMentions.title: Mentions read
maxMentions.description: Open issues and pull requests that mention you, at most. 0 = don't look for mentions.

help.en: Open issues and pull requests that mention you, at most. 0 = don't look for mentions.
help.es: Issues y pull requests abiertas que te mencionan, como mucho. 0 = no buscar menciones.
